title: eriosorus glaberrimus
intro: Eriosorus glaberrimus, commonly known as the woolly rockrose, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Compositae. The woolly rockrose has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Eriosorus glaberrimus include wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and exhibiting antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
